main_text.p: labantur: quarum præcipua laus fuit Manilianarum, & Hoftilianarũ, quas Varro in libris De re ruftica, demon- strat in omnium, etiam rufti corum, manibus uersari coñ sueuisse. Animaduertendum etiam illud est, quod in Mu- reniana Cicero de illis ipsis formulis atq; actionibus scri bit, Iurifconsultos à Cn. Fla- uio sua illa gloria atque arte spoliatos, ueritos ne sine sua opera lege posset agi, notas quasdam cóposuisse, ut om- nib. in rebus ipsi interessent. quem locum olim mihi sanè intelleƈtu difficilem, postea Manilij in lib. Astronom. lo- cus

page.notes: Running head "IVRISCONSVLTVS." is set in spaced capitals with the page number "17" printed beside it; the number is given as printed. Several words are printed with long s (s), transcribed here as plain s per the rules, e.g. "suisse" read as "sueuisse" where the scan shows "uersari coñ sueuisse"; the final word "lo-cus" is a catchword-style line at the foot of the column and is kept in the text. The first word "labantur" continues from the previous page and is marked cont="true". Ligatures in "intelleƈtu" and "actionibus" are read as printed where legible; the word "scri bit" is printed with a space and is transcribed as "scri bit" as printed.
